items.title: One app at /app with Home, Learn, Chat and Play (the Silk Road); /lens/ opens it
Install it on the phone like an app (icon, works full screen)
Home: stats and the top-5 leaderboard on top, Today's plan as a daily quest with XP, "Today's new thing" (one feature a day)
Progress charts: study calendar, words known, % remembered, cards coming up, English met
Study time logged automatically from everything done in the app
Words read and heard today, 💡 curious words today
Start here guide: features unlock step by step (stages 1–5)
Computers: sidebar, wider page, Today in two columns
English by default, one "English / العربية" switch for explanations (shared with Language Lens, saved with the account)
Coins for learning (plan steps, perfect day, quiz answers, mastery)
Review cards from Learning words, saved sentences, expressions, grammar and own mistakes; My library
FSRS-6 scheduling: fewer reviews, late reviews still count, load balancing, a log of every answer
Card levels: new cards a day grow with consistency (5 → 25); catch-up mode when reviews pile up
Cards play the video moment in the speaker's voice, loop for shadowing, slower speed
One card per saved expression (no double cards)
Pictures for words: real photos for nouns, AI pictures for the rest
Read a text: paste any text, tap words, select to save a phrase, listen to it
Read a PDF, and ✨ Adapt to my level (graded reading, i+1, shows % of known words before → after)
Scan a page: photo or screenshot → tappable text with meanings
Write & speak: writing checker with explanations, free speaking checked like writing, read-aloud for pronunciation
Skill tree (grammar, tone & politeness, pronunciation) in research order, AI practice sets, error trends
XP for checked writing, bonus XP for fixing repeated mistakes and mastering skills
Placement test at /placement/: adaptive vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, writing → CEFR level, score, vocabulary size
Find English content you'll love: 2-minute quiz, 49 categories, Arab creators → English creators, music, podcasts, books; "how much you'll follow" instead of CEFR grades
📖 Stories for you: 104 graded stories and explainers (49 topics × A2/B1) + the football series "The Bulaq Boys"; listen-along, tap a word, quick check, XP, reading streak
items.note: free for all since 0.19.0

items.title: Video quizzes (EdPuzzle-style): video pauses for questions; can be a 📺 Video or a 🎵 Song with a tappable transcript

Voice notes in chat checked as speaking (2 a day)
AI summary of beta feedback for the tracker's admin page
"Open the Sawa App to students" switch (waiting screen while closed)
Admin: video quiz editor with AI questions, Stories list (reads, finishes, scores)
Server for Language Lens: sign-in (also on phones), word sync, explanations, proofreading, Arabic → English, lyrics explained
Walkable Silk Road: towns from A2− to B1+, pixel art, day/night, phone joystick
Character creator; levels from XP, health and mana, gear grades, titles, auras, level-up celebration
Language Lens inside the game: tap any word for its meaning, + Learning, AI explain
Chat, review cards and Today's plan without leaving the game
Voice acting (every character has its own voice), sound effects, calm and battle music
Other students live or as echoes, waves, invites, notes left on the map
Explorer's journal, share card for Skool, weekly report
Monsters made from your own words, your mistakes and weak skills (with the sentence you met them in)
Town bosses, enraged bosses, elite rematches once a week
Question types: choose, listen, type the word, build your sentence; saved phrases as gaps
Dangerous, fun fights: each monster has its own attack style; roles Guardian / Healer / Mage / Trickster
Shadow duels with Elo rating and monthly arena seasons
Jobs (Thief, Hunter, Trader), raids between clans, wanted board

items.title: Coins to spend: healing tea, gifts to the caravanserai, shop

Action fights: move with the stick (or WASD), dodge the red marks, hit when the gold ring is small for combos, use your role's move; every 4 good hits a power word fires your ultimate (a wrong answer costs nothing); each camp finished today gives one more fight
Five camps between each town's gate and its boss: 📺 video → 🎵 song → 📖 story → 🃏 cards → ✍️ write; all study counts by itself
Videos and songs with a tappable transcript or lyrics under the video (phones too, no extension needed)
📜 Weekly chapter: walk the road 3/5/7 days for coins, elixirs, titles Road Walker and Pilgrim
Community goal for camps; admin Silk Road map of where every student is
Rawi the storyteller by the inn: tonight's story, gift after reading
📱 Reels in town (bonus camp): swipe through English Shorts and TikToks, say what they said, laugh at a meme; coins and the community goal
📰 Read the internet (bonus camp): today's newsletter posts with how hard they are for you; read one on its own site and say one thing you learned
📻 Radio: fun English podcasts instead of the game music, with captions where every word is tap-able; counts as study time
📚 On the road strip: how many of the 500 most common English words you know, and 10 new ones a day to add to your cards
Clans, clan race, weekly clan war
Parties with chat, 48-hour party boss, weekly team goal, weekly world boss

Community chat: replies, reactions, stickers, GIFs, voice notes (2:00), private groups

I know it / Learning / 💡 Curious (+2 XP per new word, no limit)
Daily Learning limit that follows your card level
Soft colour highlights (green next level, orange hard, yellow Learning); skips links, titles, buttons, names
Works on every website; choose hover, Alt+hover or select
Select text → Translate, How it sounds, Listen, Save sentence, Save expression, Mark grammar
Proofreader in any text box: spelling locally, grammar from Sawa English
Arabic → English: hover Arabic words, select Arabic text, optional English line under Arabic posts
English by default, Explanations language setting (English / العربية)
Captions with an Arabic 2nd line (can be blurred) and a "how it sounds" 3rd line
Language Lens menu on the player bar with on/off switches
Everyday meaning first on the word card ("now: at the present moment", not "in the historical present"); 371 meanings reordered in the 3,000 most-used words
Everyday meaning first for word meanings in the app and the Silk Road game (same dictionary as Language Lens 0.6.5)
On a phone, tap a word on any website for its card (websites were hover-only); links and buttons still work as usual
Text a site marks as another language (French, Spanish …) is no longer coloured or looked up as English
Word card: 💬 Meaning here (what the word means in this sentence) is back as a small link, and bigger links for fingers
